Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding basic education allocations for tribal schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to basic education allocations for tribal schools;and adding a new section to chapter 28A.150 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.150RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The basic education allocations generated under this chapter forstudents enrolled in tribal schools in the state that are operated byfederally recognized Indian tribes shall be allocated by thesuperintendent of public instruction to the serving tribe rather thanto the school district. A federally recognized Indian tribe operatinga tribal school may choose to continue to receive allocations througha school district pursuant to an interlocal agreement with thedistrict. Before any direct allocation of basic education moneys to a servingtribe, the superintendent of public instruction shall enter into anagreement with the serving tribe, which agreement shall assurecompliance with all applicable state and federal laws and be consistentwith the requirements imposed by the superintendent on school districts p. 1 HB 1890with respect to school district contracts with entities that employstaff to provide basic education instruction claimed by the schooldistrict for state basic education funding.
